groups.title: Start here
groups.blurb: Small programs where one rule of COBOL arithmetic decides the answer.

groups.title: Real programs
groups.blurb: Unchanged programs from the Open Mainframe Project COBOL course (CC-BY-4.0).

groups.title: Files, CALL and SORT
groups.blurb: Keyed and relative files, subprograms and sorting.

groups.title: SQL, CICS and JCL
groups.blurb: Programs that need a database, a transaction monitor or a batch job to run.

samples.name: payroll
samples.title: Payroll
samples.summary: Pay for hours and rate, with ROUNDED at every step. Includes a hand-written port that uses floats, so you can watch the check catch a real bug.

samples.name: accounts
samples.title: Accounts
samples.summary: Account balances with a copybook, level-88 account types, PERFORM VARYING and an edited output field.

samples.name: loan
samples.title: Loan
samples.summary: Monthly payment with ON SIZE ERROR for a payment that does not fit or a zero term, and exponentiation. Includes a port that crashes.

samples.name: interest
samples.title: Interest
samples.summary: Interest and an overdraft fee whose overflow silently flips -999,999,999.99 to -24.99.

samples.name: inventory
samples.title: Inventory
samples.summary: Stock above 99,999 wraps around, and shortfall backorders are cut to 5 digits.

samples.name: account_report
samples.title: Account Report (CBL0011)
samples.summary: A report with headers and totals over packed-decimal (COMP-3) account records.

samples.name: add_amounts
samples.title: Add Amounts (ADDAMT)
samples.summary: An interactive console loop that adds the numbers you type until you answer NO.

samples.name: table_search
samples.title: Table Search (SRCHBIN)
samples.summary: An OCCURS table loaded from a file and searched with SEARCH ALL.

samples.name: customer_master
samples.title: Customer Master
samples.summary: An indexed customer file updated by transactions: WRITE, READ by key, REWRITE, DELETE and START on an alternate key.

samples.name: order_pricing
samples.title: Order Pricing
samples.summary: CALLs a pricing module and a counter module whose storage persists between calls. Uses CANCEL and ON EXCEPTION.

samples.name: transaction_sort
samples.title: Transaction Sort
samples.summary: SORT on packed keys with USING/GIVING, with input and output procedures, and a SORT of a table.

samples.name: seat_bookings
samples.title: Seat Bookings
samples.summary: A relative file updated by slot number, then listed with START and READ NEXT.

samples.name: payment_posting
samples.title: Payment Posting (SQL)
samples.summary: Embedded SQL: a cursor over payments, SELECT INTO and UPDATE of account balances, and SQLCODE checks.

samples.name: customer_inquiry
samples.title: Customer Inquiry (CICS)
samples.summary: A pseudo-conversational transaction: RECEIVE MAP, READ UPDATE and REWRITE on a KSDS, WRITEQ TS, PF3 and CLEAR.

samples.name: nightly_batch
samples.title: Nightly Batch (JCL)
samples.summary: A job of four steps: SORT, the customer update, the account run only if the update ended with RC 0, then an IEBGENER backup. Also loads the two programs it runs.
